response.text: Draft/Notes: Portrait poster — glass greenhouse at night, vertical (2:3). Photorealistic: warm golden interior glow spilling through clear panes, cool moonlight rim light, mist and condensation on glass with water droplets and reflections, lush tropical plants and hanging ferns silhouetted, stone path leading to ornate iron door, cinematic depth, high detail, soft bokeh, dramatic contrast, print-ready high resolution.
